stories.title: AUSL All-Star Cup — Series 4 Draft Complete, Eve of the Finale
stories.angle: Series 4 teams are set. Tomorrow night at Parkway Bank Sports Complex, Baylee Klingler (890 pts) defends her lead against Lexi Kilfoyl (866 pts) and Hannah Flippen (750 pts) in the All-Star Cup finale. The opener: Team Klingler vs. Team Flippen, 7 PM ET on CBS Sports Network. The gap at the top is 24 points — movable in a single series.

x_posts.label: Post 1-1
x_posts.text: Series 4 draft is done. Teams are set. Tomorrow night: Klingler vs. Flippen, 7 PM ET on CBS Sports Network — the first game of the finale. Klingler leads 890-866 over Kilfoyl. 24 points. Three days to the 2026 individual champion. #AUSL 🥎

x_posts.label: Post 1-2
x_posts.text: Going into the finale: Klingler 890. Kilfoyl 866. Flippen 750. That's a 24-point gap at the top — one strong series can close it. Friday Aug 28 at 7 PM ET on CBS Sports Network, the race for the 2026 AUSL individual title begins its final stretch. #AUSL #WomensSoftball 🥎

article.headline: The Draft Is Done. Series 4 Opens Tomorrow. Three Days to the 2026 Champion.

stories.title: Texas Tech Softball — NiJaree Canady and the Preseason No. 1 Case
stories.angle: Texas Tech enters the 2027 season as the preseason No. 1 in at least one major poll, fueled by NiJaree Canady and seven transfer additions who combined for 105 home runs at their previous schools. The Red Raiders ranked 60 HRs in their prior offense — this class nearly doubles that number on paper.
